```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Purpose: Load completed computation artifacts and prepare report-only summaries.
# Input: Data audit, the stage-02 products, biology cache, and stage-04 structural results.
# Parameters: Display thresholds from YAML params; no scientific winner threshold is invented.
# Output: Traceable variables used by inline numbers, tables, and figures.
# Stage 01 prepares one self-consistent CCS object with complete precomputed d1
# rows and the filtered model-bank contract.
knitr::opts_knit$set(encoding = "UTF-8")
if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  utf8_locale <- Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "Chinese_China.utf8")
  if (!nzchar(utf8_locale)) stop("A UTF-8 Windows locale is required to render this report.", call. = FALSE)
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)
env_path <- c(
  file.path(getwd(), "00.Environment.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "test", "ablation-03", "00.Environment.R")
)
env_path <- env_path[file.exists(env_path)][1L]
if (is.na(env_path)) stop("ablation-03: knit from the project directory or repository root.", call. = FALSE)
source(env_path)
source(.ablation03_path("02-ablation03-experiment_functions.R"))
source(.ablation03_path("templates", "nature_colors.R"))
source(.ablation03_path("templates", "nature_theme.R"))
source(.ablation03_path("templates", "plot_delivery_helpers.R"))
source(.ablation03_path("templates", "datatables_helper.R"))

result_dir <- .ablation03_path("tmp", "ablation-experiment")
data_profile_path <- file.path(result_dir, "data-profile.rds")
data_report_name <- "01-ablation-test-data.Rmd"
data_report_html_name <- "01-ablation-test-data.html"
required_results <- c(
  data_profile_path,
  file.path(
    result_dir,
  c(
    "manifest.rds",
    "native_geometry.rds",
    "retrieval.rds",
    "readout.rds",
    "learning_curve.rds",
    "cohort_scaling.rds",
    "tradeoffs.rds",
    "ablation-result.rds"
  )
  )
)
if (!all(file.exists(required_results))) {
  stop("The completed ablation result set is unavailable.", call. = FALSE)
}

data_profile <- readRDS(data_profile_path)
manifest <- readRDS(file.path(result_dir, "manifest.rds"))
native_geometry <- readRDS(file.path(result_dir, "native_geometry.rds"))
retrieval <- readRDS(file.path(result_dir, "retrieval.rds"))
readout <- readRDS(file.path(result_dir, "readout.rds"))
learning_curve <- readRDS(file.path(result_dir, "learning_curve.rds"))
cohort_scaling <- readRDS(file.path(result_dir, "cohort_scaling.rds"))
tradeoffs <- readRDS(file.path(result_dir, "tradeoffs.rds"))
ablation_result <- readRDS(file.path(result_dir, "ablation-result.rds"))
biology_dir <- .ablation03_path("tmp", "ablation-biology")
biology_files <- file.path(
  biology_dir,
  c("anchor_coverage.csv", "anchor_utility.csv", "anchor_contrasts.csv",
    "anchor_inference.csv")
)
biology_available <- all(file.exists(biology_files))
if (biology_available) {
  biology_coverage <- read.csv(biology_files[1L], check.names = FALSE)
  biology_utility <- read.csv(biology_files[2L], check.names = FALSE)
  biology_contrasts <- read.csv(biology_files[3L], check.names = FALSE)
  biology_inference <- read.csv(biology_files[4L], check.names = FALSE)
} else {
  biology_coverage <- data.frame()
  biology_utility <- data.frame()
  biology_contrasts <- data.frame()
  biology_inference <- data.frame()
}
biology_status <- if (biology_available && nrow(biology_utility) > 0L &&
  nrow(biology_inference) > 0L) {
  "complete"
} else {
  "not_estimable"
}
structural_dir <- .ablation03_path(
  "tmp", "ablation-structural-reproducibility"
)
structural_paths <- file.path(
  structural_dir,
  c(
    "structural_entity_audit.csv",
    "structural_pair_comparisons.csv",
    "structural_summary.csv",
    "structural_similarity_matrices.rds",
    "ablation03-structural-reproducibility.rds"
  )
)
if (!all(file.exists(structural_paths))) {
  stop(
    "The structural reproducibility results are unavailable; run stage 04.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
structural_entity_audit <- read.csv(structural_paths[1L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_pairs <- read.csv(structural_paths[2L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_summary <- read.csv(structural_paths[3L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_matrices <- readRDS(structural_paths[4L])
structural_result <- readRDS(structural_paths[5L])
directional_paths <- file.path(
  structural_dir,
  c(
    "structural_directional_summary.csv",
    "structural_directional_sample_audit.csv",
    "structural_module_bank_audit.csv",
    "structural_matched_bank_repeats.csv",
    "structural_matched_bank_summary.csv"
  )
)
if (!all(file.exists(directional_paths))) {
  stop(
    "The reciprocal structural results are unavailable; rerun stage 04.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
structural_directional_summary <- read.csv(
  directional_paths[1L], check.names = FALSE
)
structural_sample_audit <- read.csv(directional_paths[2L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_module_banks <- read.csv(directional_paths[3L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_matched_repeats <- read.csv(directional_paths[4L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_matched_summary <- read.csv(directional_paths[5L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_functions_name <-
  "04-ablation03-structural-reproducibility_functions.R"
structural_all <- structural_summary[
  structural_summary$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_same_cancer <- structural_summary[
  structural_summary$scope == "same_cancer_type",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_forward_all <- structural_directional_summary[
  structural_directional_summary$direction ==
    "reference_bank_to_external_targets" &
    structural_directional_summary$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_reverse_all <- structural_directional_summary[
  structural_directional_summary$direction ==
    "external_bank_to_reference_targets" &
    structural_directional_summary$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_matched_all <- structural_matched_repeats[
  structural_matched_repeats$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_matched_all$direction_label <- factor(
  structural_matched_all$direction,
  levels = c(
    "reference_bank_to_external_targets",
    "external_bank_to_reference_targets"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Reference modules\non external targets",
    "External modules\non reference targets"
  )
)
structural_reference_modules <- sum(
  structural_module_banks$bank_role == "reference"
)
structural_external_modules <- sum(
  structural_module_banks$bank_role == "external"
)
structural_matched_modules <- unique(
  structural_matched_summary$bank_module_count
)[1L]
structural_matched_forward_all <- structural_matched_summary[
  structural_matched_summary$direction ==
    "reference_bank_to_external_targets" &
    structural_matched_summary$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_matched_reverse_all <- structural_matched_summary[
  structural_matched_summary$direction ==
    "external_bank_to_reference_targets" &
    structural_matched_summary$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_best <- structural_pairs[
  which.max(structural_pairs$delta_d1_minus_direct),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_worst <- structural_pairs[
  which.min(structural_pairs$delta_d1_minus_direct),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_paired_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    pair_id = seq_len(nrow(structural_pairs)),
    representation = "Direct-GSClassifier",
    similarity = structural_pairs$direct_similarity
  ),
  data.frame(
    pair_id = seq_len(nrow(structural_pairs)),
    representation = "Cohort-d1",
    similarity = structural_pairs$d1_similarity
  )
)
structural_paired_long$representation <- factor(
  structural_paired_long$representation,
  levels = c("Direct-GSClassifier", "Cohort-d1")
)
structural_cohorts <- rownames(structural_matrices[["Direct-GSClassifier"]])
structural_labels <- sub("/TCGATARGET-", "/TCGA-", structural_cohorts)
structural_labels <- gsub("/", "\n", structural_labels, fixed = TRUE)
names(structural_labels) <- structural_cohorts
structural_matrix_long <- function(matrix, representation) {
  data <- as.data.frame(as.table(matrix), responseName = "similarity")
  names(data)[1:2] <- c("cohort_a", "cohort_b")
  data$representation <- representation
  data$cohort_a <- factor(
    data$cohort_a,
    levels = structural_cohorts,
    labels = unname(structural_labels[structural_cohorts])
  )
  data$cohort_b <- factor(
    data$cohort_b,
    levels = rev(structural_cohorts),
    labels = unname(structural_labels[rev(structural_cohorts)])
  )
  data
}
structural_direct_heatmap <- structural_matrix_long(
  structural_matrices[["Direct-GSClassifier"]],
  "Direct-GSClassifier"
)
structural_d1_heatmap <- structural_matrix_long(
  structural_matrices[["Cohort-d1"]],
  "Cohort-d1"
)

# ablation-03 extends, rather than replaces, every ablation-02 result loaded above.
if (cohort_scaling$status != "complete") {
  stop("The representation cohort-bank scaling result is incomplete.", call. = FALSE)
}

figure_dir <- .ablation03_path("figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
preview_dir <- bensz_run_dir(
  .ablation03_path(params$plot_run_dir),
  prefix = "02-ablation-experiment"
)

fmt <- function(x, digits = 3L) formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "f")
fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1L) paste0(fmt(100 * x, digits), "%")
fmt_p <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x), format.pval(x, digits = 3, eps = 1e-3), "NA")
fmt_ci <- function(x) paste0("[", fmt(x$ci_low), ", ", fmt(x$ci_high), "]")
metric_value <- function(name) {
  native_geometry$metrics$metric_value[
    match(name, native_geometry$metrics$metric_name)
  ]
}
find_source_line <- function(pattern) .ae_find_source_line(
  .ablation03_repo_path("R", "ablation.R"),
  pattern
)

geometry_metrics <- native_geometry$metrics[
  native_geometry$metrics$metric_name %in%
    c("linear_cka", "distance_spearman", "knn_jaccard"),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
geometry_metrics$metric_label <- c(
  linear_cka = "Linear CKA",
  distance_spearman = "Distance Spearman",
  knn_jaccard = "kNN Jaccard"
)[geometry_metrics$metric_name]
geometry_inference <- .ae_geometry_inference(native_geometry)

retrieval_cohort_delta <- .ae_retrieval_cohort_delta(retrieval, params$display_k)
retrieval_delta_main <- retrieval_cohort_delta[
  retrieval_cohort_delta$metric == "delta_top_k_label_rate" &
    retrieval_cohort_delta$sample_count >= params$min_cohort_n,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
retrieval_top <- retrieval_delta_main[
  order(retrieval_delta_main$estimate, decreasing = TRUE),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
retrieval_bottom <- retrieval_delta_main[
  order(retrieval_delta_main$estimate),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
retrieval_overall <- retrieval$paired[
  retrieval$paired$k == params$display_k,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
retrieval_mean_delta <- mean(
  retrieval_overall$delta_top_k_label_rate,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
retrieval_mrr_delta <- mean(retrieval_overall$delta_mrr, na.rm = TRUE)
retrieval_sample_mean_delta <- retrieval_mean_delta
retrieval_sample_mrr_delta <- retrieval_mrr_delta
retrieval_direct_mrr <- mean(retrieval_overall$mrr_direct, na.rm = TRUE)
retrieval_d1_mrr <- mean(retrieval_overall$mrr_d1, na.rm = TRUE)

# Cohort-level inferential layer.  Direct and d1 are already paired in the
# upstream artifacts; the helper resamples complete cohorts and records status.
retrieval_inference <- .ae_retrieval_inference(
  retrieval,
  k = params$display_k,
  n_boot = params$inference_bootstrap,
  seed = params$inference_seed
)
retrieval_cohort_mean_delta <- retrieval_inference$estimate[
  retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"
]
retrieval_cohort_mrr_delta <- retrieval_inference$estimate[
  retrieval_inference$endpoint == "mrr"
]

readout_overall <- readout$overall
readout_direct <- readout_overall[
  readout_overall$representation == "Direct-GSClassifier",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
readout_d1 <- readout_overall[
  readout_overall$representation == "Cohort-d1",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
readout_delta <- readout_d1$balanced_accuracy - readout_direct$balanced_accuracy
readout_cohort <- readout$paired_by_cohort
readout_cohort <- readout_cohort[
  pmax(readout_cohort$sample_count_d1, readout_cohort$sample_count_direct) >=
    params$min_cohort_n,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
readout_top <- readout_cohort[
  order(readout_cohort$delta_accuracy, decreasing = TRUE),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
readout_bottom <- readout_cohort[
  order(readout_cohort$delta_accuracy),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
readout_inference <- .ae_readout_inference(
  readout,
  n_boot = params$inference_bootstrap,
  seed = params$inference_seed + 100L
)
readout_inference_delta <- readout_inference$estimate[
  readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"
]

learning_summary <- .ae_learning_summary(learning_curve)
learning_delta <- learning_curve$paired |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$requested_fraction) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    estimate = mean(.data$delta_balanced_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = stats::sd(.data$delta_balanced_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sqrt(sum(is.finite(.data$delta_balanced_accuracy))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
learning_inference <- .ae_learning_inference(
  learning_curve,
  n_boot = params$inference_bootstrap,
  seed = params$inference_seed + 200L
)
scaling_inference <- .ae_scaling_inference(
  cohort_scaling,
  n_boot = params$inference_bootstrap,
  seed = params$inference_seed + 300L
)
learning_ci <- learning_inference[, c("requested_fraction", "ci_low", "ci_high")]
learning_summary <- dplyr::left_join(
  learning_summary,
  learning_ci,
  by = "requested_fraction"
)
learning_rep_ci <- learning_curve$metrics |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$representation,
    .data$requested_fraction,
    .data$cohort_subset_hash
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    balanced_accuracy = mean(.data$balanced_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
learning_rep_ci <- split(
  learning_rep_ci,
  interaction(
    learning_rep_ci$representation,
    learning_rep_ci$requested_fraction,
    drop = TRUE
  )
)
learning_rep_ci <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(learning_rep_ci), function(i) {
  part <- learning_rep_ci[[i]]
  out <- .ae_paired_inference(
    part,
    "balanced_accuracy",
    cluster_column = "cohort_subset_hash",
    n_boot = params$inference_bootstrap,
    seed = params$inference_seed + 250L + i,
    unit = "unique_training_cohort_design",
    method = "representation_design_bootstrap",
    min_clusters = 2L
  )
  data.frame(
    representation = part$representation[1],
    requested_fraction = part$requested_fraction[1],
    ci_low_rep = out$ci_low,
    ci_high_rep = out$ci_high,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
learning_summary <- dplyr::left_join(
  learning_summary,
  learning_rep_ci,
  by = c("representation", "requested_fraction")
)
forest_data <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    endpoint = "Retrieval top-k label rate",
    estimate = retrieval_inference$estimate[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"],
    ci_low = retrieval_inference$ci_low[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"],
    ci_high = retrieval_inference$ci_high[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"],
    p_value = retrieval_inference$p_value_adj[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"],
    unit = "cohort"
  ),
  data.frame(
    endpoint = "Retrieval MRR",
    estimate = retrieval_inference$estimate[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "mrr"],
    ci_low = retrieval_inference$ci_low[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "mrr"],
    ci_high = retrieval_inference$ci_high[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "mrr"],
    p_value = retrieval_inference$p_value_adj[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "mrr"],
    unit = "cohort"
  ),
  data.frame(
    endpoint = "Readout cohort accuracy",
    estimate = readout_inference$estimate[readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"],
    ci_low = readout_inference$ci_low[readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"],
    ci_high = readout_inference$ci_high[readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"],
    p_value = readout_inference$p_value_adj[readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"],
    unit = "query cohort"
  ),
  data.frame(
    endpoint = "Learning curve at 100%",
    estimate = learning_inference$estimate[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1],
    ci_low = learning_inference$ci_low[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1],
    ci_high = learning_inference$ci_high[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1],
    p_value = learning_inference$p_value_adj[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1],
    unit = "unique training-cohort design"
  )
)
forest_data$endpoint <- factor(forest_data$endpoint, levels = rev(forest_data$endpoint))
if (!identical(cohort_scaling$schema_version, 2L)) {
  stop("The cohort scaling result must use schema version 2.", call. = FALSE)
}
scaling_metric_names <- c(
  "normalized_effective_rank",
  "module_covariance_redundancy",
  "neighbor_stability"
)
scaling_metric_labels <- c(
  normalized_effective_rank = "Effective rank",
  module_covariance_redundancy = "Module redundancy",
  neighbor_stability = "Neighbor stability"
)
scaling_sequence <- cohort_scaling$metrics |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$status == "evaluated",
    .data$query_coverage == "all",
    .data$design_family %in% c("breadth", "depth"),
    .data$metric_name %in% scaling_metric_names
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    scaling_axis = ifelse(
      .data$design_family == "breadth",
      .data$tissue_count,
      .data$level
    ),
    design_label = dplyr::recode(
      .data$design_family,
      breadth = "Tissue breadth",
      depth = "Within-tissue depth"
    ),
    metric_label = unname(scaling_metric_labels[.data$metric_name])
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$design_family,
    .data$design_label,
    .data$metric_name,
    .data$metric_label,
    .data$scaling_axis
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    estimate = mean(.data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = stats::sd(.data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sqrt(sum(is.finite(.data$estimate))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
scaling_sequence_repeat <- cohort_scaling$metrics |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$status == "evaluated",
    .data$query_coverage == "all",
    .data$design_family %in% c("breadth", "depth"),
    .data$metric_name %in% scaling_metric_names
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    scaling_axis = ifelse(
      .data$design_family == "breadth",
      .data$tissue_count,
      .data$level
    ),
    design_label = dplyr::recode(
      .data$design_family,
      breadth = "Tissue breadth",
      depth = "Within-tissue depth"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$design_label, .data$metric_name, .data$scaling_axis, .data$repeat_id
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(repeat_estimate = mean(.data$estimate), .groups = "drop")
scaling_sequence_ci <- split(
  scaling_sequence_repeat,
  interaction(
    scaling_sequence_repeat$design_label,
    scaling_sequence_repeat$metric_name,
    scaling_sequence_repeat$scaling_axis,
    drop = TRUE
  )
)
scaling_sequence_ci <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(scaling_sequence_ci), function(i) {
  part <- scaling_sequence_ci[[i]]
  out <- .ae_paired_inference(
    part,
    "repeat_estimate",
    cluster_column = "repeat_id",
    n_boot = params$inference_bootstrap,
    seed = params$inference_seed + 350L + i,
    unit = "design_repeat",
    method = "scaling_cell_repeat_bootstrap",
    min_clusters = 2L
  )
  data.frame(
    design_label = part$design_label[1],
    metric_name = part$metric_name[1],
    scaling_axis = part$scaling_axis[1],
    ci_low_seq = out$ci_low,
    ci_high_seq = out$ci_high,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
scaling_sequence <- dplyr::left_join(
  scaling_sequence,
  scaling_sequence_ci,
  by = c("design_label", "metric_name", "scaling_axis")
)

scaling_matched_raw <- cohort_scaling$metrics |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$status == "evaluated",
    .data$query_coverage == "all",
    .data$design_family == "matched",
    .data$metric_name %in% scaling_metric_names
  )
scaling_matched_breadth <- scaling_matched_raw |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$design_role == "breadth_heavy") |>
  dplyr::select(
    .data$repeat_id,
    .data$pair_id,
    .data$module_count,
    .data$metric_name,
    estimate_breadth = .data$estimate
  )
scaling_matched_depth <- scaling_matched_raw |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$design_role == "depth_heavy") |>
  dplyr::select(
    .data$repeat_id,
    .data$pair_id,
    .data$module_count,
    .data$metric_name,
    estimate_depth = .data$estimate
  )
scaling_matched <- dplyr::inner_join(
  scaling_matched_breadth,
  scaling_matched_depth,
  by = c("repeat_id", "pair_id", "module_count", "metric_name")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta = .data$estimate_breadth - .data$estimate_depth,
    metric_label = unname(scaling_metric_labels[.data$metric_name])
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$module_count, .data$metric_name, .data$metric_label) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    estimate = mean(.data$delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = stats::sd(.data$delta, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sqrt(sum(is.finite(.data$delta))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
scaling_matched_repeat <- dplyr::inner_join(
  scaling_matched_breadth,
  scaling_matched_depth,
  by = c("repeat_id", "pair_id", "module_count", "metric_name")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(delta = .data$estimate_breadth - .data$estimate_depth) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$module_count, .data$metric_name, .data$repeat_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(repeat_estimate = mean(.data$delta), .groups = "drop")
scaling_matched_ci <- split(
  scaling_matched_repeat,
  interaction(
    scaling_matched_repeat$module_count,
    scaling_matched_repeat$metric_name,
    drop = TRUE
  )
)
scaling_matched_ci <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(scaling_matched_ci), function(i) {
  part <- scaling_matched_ci[[i]]
  out <- .ae_paired_inference(
    part,
    "repeat_estimate",
    cluster_column = "repeat_id",
    n_boot = params$inference_bootstrap,
    seed = params$inference_seed + 450L + i,
    unit = "design_repeat",
    method = "matched_size_repeat_bootstrap",
    min_clusters = 2L
  )
  data.frame(
    module_count = part$module_count[1],
    metric_name = part$metric_name[1],
    ci_low_matched = out$ci_low,
    ci_high_matched = out$ci_high,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
scaling_matched <- dplyr::left_join(
  scaling_matched,
  scaling_matched_ci,
  by = c("module_count", "metric_name")
)

scaling_contrast <- function(type, metric) {
  result <- cohort_scaling$contrasts[
    cohort_scaling$contrasts$aggregation == "bootstrap_summary" &
      cohort_scaling$contrasts$contrast_type == type &
      cohort_scaling$contrasts$metric_name == metric,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (nrow(result) == 0L) {
    return(data.frame(estimate = NA_real_, ci_low = NA_real_, ci_high = NA_real_))
  }
  result[1, , drop = FALSE]
}
rank_breadth <- scaling_contrast("breadth_slope", "normalized_effective_rank")
rank_depth <- scaling_contrast("depth_slope", "normalized_effective_rank")
redundancy_breadth <- scaling_contrast(
  "breadth_slope",
  "module_covariance_redundancy"
)
redundancy_depth <- scaling_contrast(
  "depth_slope",
  "module_covariance_redundancy"
)
stability_breadth <- scaling_contrast("breadth_slope", "neighbor_stability")
stability_depth <- scaling_contrast("depth_slope", "neighbor_stability")
rank_matched <- scaling_contrast("matched_size", "normalized_effective_rank")
redundancy_matched <- scaling_contrast(
  "matched_size",
  "module_covariance_redundancy"
)
stability_matched <- scaling_contrast("matched_size", "neighbor_stability")
scaling_main_contract <- cohort_scaling$diagnostics$direct_contracts[
  cohort_scaling$diagnostics$direct_contracts$contract_role == "main",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
scaling_sensitivity_contract <- cohort_scaling$diagnostics$direct_contracts[
  cohort_scaling$diagnostics$direct_contracts$contract_role == "sensitivity",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
biology_scaling_status <- cohort_scaling$reasons[
  cohort_scaling$reasons$evidence_layer == "external_biology",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
if (nrow(biology_scaling_status) == 0L) {
  biology_scaling_status <- data.frame(
    status = "evaluated",
    reason = "configured_independent_anchors_available",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

technical_columns <- manifest$config$anchors$technical
technical_delta <- .ae_technical_delta(
  retrieval,
  params$display_k,
  technical_columns
)
technical_inference <- .ae_technical_inference(
  retrieval,
  params$display_k,
  technical_columns,
  n_boot = params$inference_bootstrap,
  seed = params$inference_seed + 400L,
  multiplicity_method = "holm"
)
technical_inference_summary <- if (nrow(technical_inference) > 0L) {
  paste(
    technical_inference$technical_factor,
    sprintf(
      "d1\u2212Direct=%+.3f, 95%% CI [%+.3f, %+.3f], Holm P=%s",
      technical_inference$estimate,
      technical_inference$ci_low,
      technical_inference$ci_high,
      vapply(
        technical_inference$p_value_adj,
        fmt_p,
        character(1L)
      )
    ),
    sep = ": ",
    collapse = "; "
  )
} else {
  "not_estimable"
}
technical_inference_significant <- if (nrow(technical_inference) > 0L) {
  paste(
    technical_inference$technical_factor[
      is.finite(technical_inference$p_value_adj) &
        technical_inference$p_value_adj < 0.05 &
        technical_inference$ci_high < 0
    ],
    collapse = ", "
  )
} else {
  ""
}
technical_summary <- technical_delta |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$technical_factor) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_delta = mean(.data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_delta = stats::median(.data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_delta = min(.data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_delta = max(.data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    cohort_count = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
technical_query_counts <- stats::aggregate(
  sample_count ~ technical_factor,
  data = technical_delta,
  FUN = sum
)

module_diagnostics <- native_geometry$module_diagnostics
module_top <- module_diagnostics[
  order(module_diagnostics$variance_share, decreasing = TRUE),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
] |>
  utils::head(20L)
module_concentration_top10 <- sum(module_top$variance_share[seq_len(10L)])
module_equal_share <- 1 / manifest$module_count
module_equal_top10_share <- 10 / manifest$module_count

decoder_summary <- tradeoffs$decoder$summary
annoy_recall_direct <- retrieval$search_validation$`Direct-GSClassifier`$recall
annoy_recall_d1 <- retrieval$search_validation$`Cohort-d1`$recall
null_perm_status <- ablation_result$controls$null_perm$status
null_rp_k30 <- ablation_result$controls$null_rp$summary[
  ablation_result$controls$null_rp$summary$k == params$display_k,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
null_rp_top_k_range <- range(null_rp_k30$top_k_label_rate)
d1_top_k_rate <- retrieval$summary$top_k_label_rate[
  retrieval$summary$k == params$display_k &
    retrieval$summary$representation == "Cohort-d1"
]
direct_top_k_rate <- retrieval$summary$top_k_label_rate[
  retrieval$summary$k == params$display_k &
    retrieval$summary$representation == "Direct-GSClassifier"
]
```

本报告关注两个相互衔接的问题：冻结 cohort bank 将 `r manifest$direct_feature_count` 维 GSClassifier 原生输入重编码为 d1 后，技术边界、lineage recoverability 和输入重建如何变化；继续增加 cohort evidence 时，非冗余信息与邻域稳定性究竟来自 tissue breadth，还是来自既有 tissue 内的 cohort depth。主 scaling 合同使用 `r scaling_main_contract$feature_count` 维完整 `r scaling_main_contract$group`，`r scaling_sensitivity_contract$feature_count` 维 `r scaling_sensitivity_contract$group` 仅作为明确标记的 gene-pair 敏感性诊断。

可以把 Direct-GSClassifier 想成一本保存原始线索的详细笔记，把 d1 想成 `r manifest$module_count` 位“队列评委”读完笔记后分别给出的判断。我们不是先问哪本笔记分数更高，而是依次确认：新笔记是否真的换了一种组织信息的方式、是否减弱了不希望保留的技术来源痕迹、压缩时丢掉了什么，以及增加更多评委时得到的是新意见还是重复意见。

**核心结论不应由癌种分类单独承担。** d1 的首要算法目标，是在整合更多、更多样的 cohort evidence 时削弱癌种中心化和技术来源捷径，同时尽量保留可迁移的生物结构。总体结果支持这一目标：d1 重新组织了 Direct 的样本几何，降低了旧癌种标签的中心化和同技术来源样本的额外聚集；与此同时，整体关系没有普遍崩坏，说明它不是无选择地破坏信息，而是在做有方向的表示重编码。局部 expression anchor 的轻微损失应被理解为这一去中心化/压缩过程的代价，而不是算法失败。后文会在每个指标第一次进入结果解读时说明“是什么、怎么算、数值怎样读”，再结合本次动态结果给出判断。由于独立 pathway、TME 或 outcome 锚点当前为 **`r biology_scaling_status$status`**，本报告仍不把 d1 外推为所有下游任务都更优；这项边界约束的是泛化效用的强度，不是否定 d1 已展示出的表示层价值。

## 数据概览

### 实验数据与表示定义

原始 filtered 集合包含 `r length(data_profile$filtered_key_audit$cohort_key)` 个 cohort。其中，`r manifest$query_cohort_count` 个 cohort 的 cancer_type 在 reference 中至少覆盖 `r manifest$config$anchors$min_reference_cohorts` 个 cohort，共得到 `r manifest$query_sample_count` 个确认性 query。reference atlas 包含 `r manifest$reference_sample_count` 个可唯一对齐的样本，来自 `r manifest$reference_cohort_count` 个 cohort。所有 query 的 d1 provenance 均为 `external_frozen`；独立锚点取自 Excel 证据层中的 `r manifest$anchor`，本轮证据等级为 **`r manifest$evidence_level`**。Direct-GSClassifier 使用 `r manifest$direct_feature_count` 个真实冻结特征，其中包含 `r manifest$tsp_feature_count` 个 ordinary gene-pair；Cohort-d1 则由 `r manifest$module_count` 个冻结 module 产生 `r manifest$d1_feature_count` 个概率输出列。

在画图和比较分数之前，先把样本、cohort、特征和 module 的数量摊开，是为了确认两种表示面对的是同一批题目，而不是一边题目简单、另一边题目困难。下面的表像实验的“装箱清单”：reference 是可供查找的答案库，query 是从未进入该答案库的新题，feature 是原始线索，module 是不同队列模型给出的证据单元。计数本身不判胜负，它们的价值是让任何性能差异都能追溯到明确且公平的比较对象。

```{r data-overview-table}
# Purpose: Expose the exact data and representation contract used by all analyses.
# Input: manifest.rds.
# Parameters: Eleven visible rows; horizontal scrolling retained for audit fields.
# Output: Interactive data overview table.
overview_table <- data.frame(
  item = c(
    "Evidence level",
    "Reference samples",
    "External query samples",
    "Reference cohorts",
    "External filtered cohorts",
    "Direct features",
    "Gene signature size",
    "Ordinary gene-pairs",
    "d1 modules",
    "d1 output columns",
    "Direct / d1 distance"
  ),
  value = c(
    manifest$evidence_level,
    manifest$reference_sample_count,
    manifest$query_sample_count,
    manifest$reference_cohort_count,
    manifest$query_cohort_count,
    manifest$direct_feature_count,
    manifest$gene_signature_count,
    manifest$tsp_feature_count,
    manifest$module_count,
    manifest$d1_feature_count,
    paste(manifest$direct_distance, manifest$d1_distance, sep = " / ")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
render_dt(overview_table, pageLength = 11)
```

这些计数界定了本次比较的对象：同一批表达样本在两种表示下的结果。主消融和 scaling 的主 Direct 合同都使用完整 `r manifest$direct_feature_count` 维 GSClassifier 输入；`r manifest$tsp_feature_count` 个 ordinary gene-pair 只作为 `Direct-GSClassifier-TSP` 敏感性合同。另有 `r length(tradeoffs$excluded_duplicate_samples)` 个跨 cohort 重复的 sample ID 被整体排除，避免同名样本在 reference/query 对齐时被误当作配对。完整的数据构成、tissue 恢复结果和来源异质性见第一阶段报告 `r data_report_html_name`。

## 关键函数、参数与源代码位置

这一表不是为了让客户阅读代码，而是说明每个结论由哪台“测量仪器”产生、旋钮设在哪里、为什么这样设。若某项结果令人意外，客户可以沿着对象、参数和源文件回查，而不必把整份报告当成无法拆开的黑箱；这也是区分“数据真的这样”与“参数选择造成这样”的必要步骤。

| 分析过程/产物 | 关键函数/对象 | 关键参数 | 本次设置理由 | 源代码位置 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 数据审计输入 | `data_profile` | `r data_profile_path` | 复用第一阶段完整画像，不在实验报告中重复加载或重画数据审计 | `r data_report_name` |
| 完整 GSClassifier 输入 | `.ablation_gsclassifier_matrix()` | 冻结 `geneSet`、`breakVec`、feature manifest | 保留 32 single-bin、496 gene-pair、1 set-pair 的真实合同 | `R/ablation.R:` `r find_source_line(".ablation_gsclassifier_matrix <- function")` |
| 完整 d1 入口 | Stage 01 将 full `resCCS` 的 d1 行按筛选版对象的冻结列合同合并 | 只在分析入口做一次性对象适配，不修改 CCS 包函数或写 external-d1-cache | `ablation()` 接收单一自洽 CCS 对象，query 缺失时仍按通用路径重编码 | `R/ablation.R:` `r find_source_line(".ablation_prepare_representation_input <- function")` |
| query-to-reference 检索 | `.ablation_query_reference_retrieval()` + `.ae_retrieval_inference()` | k = `r paste(manifest$config$geometry$k, collapse = "/")`；cohort bootstrap = `r params$inference_bootstrap` | query 只到其它 cohorts 的 atlas 找邻居；按 cohort 估计 CI 与配对 p 值 | `R/ablation.R:` `r find_source_line(".ablation_query_reference_retrieval <- function")`；`02-ablation03-experiment_functions.R` |
| d1 距离 | `.ablation_module_balanced_transform()` | module 等权标准化 Euclidean | d1 blocks 的行和不满足 simplex，故不伪用 Hellinger | `R/ablation.R:` `r find_source_line(".ablation_module_balanced_transform <- function")` |
| 外部 readout | `.ablation_linear_readout()` + `.ae_readout_inference()` | grouped `r manifest$config$validation$inner_folds`-fold CV；lambda = `r paste(manifest$config$validation$lambda, collapse = "/")` | 预处理与调参均在 reference 内完成，两臂预算一致；query cohort bootstrap 单独报告 | `R/ablation.R:` `r find_source_line(".ablation_linear_readout <- function")`；`02-ablation03-experiment_functions.R` |
| 配对学习曲线 | `.ablation_learning_curve()` + `.ae_learning_inference()` | `r paste(100 * manifest$config$validation$learning_fractions, collapse = "/")`% × `r manifest$config$validation$repeats` repeats | 区分小样本归纳偏置与信息上限；以唯一 training-cohort design 做配对 CI | `R/ablation.R:` `r find_source_line(".ablation_learning_curve <- function")`；`02-ablation03-experiment_functions.R` |
| cohort-evidence scaling | `.ablation_cohort_bank_design()` / `.ablation_representation_scaling()` | breadth、depth、matched-size × `r manifest$config$scaling$sequences` repeats；完整 Direct 主合同 + TSP sensitivity | 分离 tissue breadth 与 within-tissue depth；bootstrap 只重采样 design repeat | `R/ablation.R:` `r find_source_line(".ablation_cohort_bank_design <- function")` |
| 双向独立队列结构可复现性 | `.asr_evaluate_direction()` / `.asr_matched_bank_design()` | `r length(structural_result$method$anchors)` 个表达锚点的队列内高低三分位，共 `r length(unique(structural_entity_audit$entity))` 个实体；双向 bank-to-target 投影；`r structural_matched_modules` 对 `r structural_matched_modules` tissue-matched modules × 20 repeats | 以目标样本是否参与所用 module 训练定义 externality，分别检查两个方向并隔离 bank 规模/组成敏感性 | `r structural_functions_name` |
| 信息损失 | `.ablation_decode_direct_features()` | rank = `r tradeoffs$decoder$rank`；ridge lambda = `r tradeoffs$decoder$lambda` | 按 feature type 量化 d1 无法恢复的原生输入 | `R/ablation.R:` `r find_source_line(".ablation_decode_direct_features <- function")` |

## 指标导读

本表是一份便于回查的快速索引，集中列出理论范围、趋势方向和通俗含义。端点是可靠锚点，但中间值通常没有跨数据集通用的及格线；为了让第一次阅读报告的读者不必在章节之间来回跳转，后文会在每个指标第一次进入结果解读时再次说明计算方法，并立即结合本次数字解释。

| 指标 | 取值范围 | 意义（包括趋势变化） | 通俗解读 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Annoy neighbor recall | 零至一（含端点） | 越接近一，近似检索找回的 exact kNN 邻居越完整；下降到门槛以下时，后续邻域差异可能来自搜索误差 | 像快速翻通讯录找朋友：一表示一个都没漏，越低表示漏掉的人越多 |
| Linear CKA | 零至一（含端点） | 升高表示两种表示的整体几何更相似；降低表示全局结构被改写得更多，但不直接代表好坏 | 像比较两张班级座位图：越接近一，整张图越像 |
| Distance Spearman | 负一至一（含端点） | 升高表示样本远近排序更一致；接近零表示缺少稳定排序关系，负值表示顺序趋向反转 | 像比较两份“从近到远”名单：一表示顺序完全一样，负值像把顺序倒过来 |
| kNN Jaccard | 零至一（含端点） | 升高表示两种表示共享更多局部邻居；降低表示“谁挨着谁”被重新排列 | 像比较两张好友名单：一表示好友完全相同，零表示一个都不一样 |
| Neighbor stability | 零至一（含端点） | 升高表示更换 bank 组成后邻居关系仍稳定；降低表示结果更依赖某次抽样 | 像每次重新排队后，好朋友是否还站在一起；越高越稳定 |
| top-k 癌种一致率 | 零至一（含端点） | 升高表示前 k 个邻居更常与 query 同癌种，旧癌种边界更强；降低表示去癌种中心化增强 | 像看最相近的 k 位同学里有多少来自同一个班，越多分数越高 |
| MRR | 零至一（含端点） | 升高表示首个同癌种邻居出现得更靠前；降低表示需要向后找更久 | 像排队找第一个同班同学：排第一得满分，排得越后分越低，找不到记零 |
| Balanced accuracy | 零至一（含端点）；随机基线随类别数变化 | 升高表示各类别被更公平地识别；降低表示至少部分小类别更难识别，不能把多分类任务机械套用二分类基线 | 像每个班都有同样的一票，大班不能靠人数多把小班淹没 |
| Macro-AUROC | 零至一（含端点）；二分之一约为随机排序 | 升高表示各癌种更容易排在正确一侧；接近二分之一表示接近随机，低于二分之一表示排序方向可能反了 | 像把同班和不同班同学排成两队：越接近一，排得越整齐 |
| Normalized effective rank | 大于零且不超过一；下界随最大秩变化 | 升高表示非重复的信息方向占可用容量的比例增大；降低表示信息相对更集中在少数方向 | 像一盒彩笔里真正不同的颜色比例：颜色越多，能画出的内容越丰富 |
| Module redundancy | 零至一（含端点） | 升高表示 modules 之间更像重复信息；降低表示每个 module 提供的独立信息更多 | 像很多人重复同一句话：越接近一，重复越多 |
| Scaling slope | 没有统一固定范围；零表示平均不变 | 本报告按 `log2(module_count)` 拟合，斜率表示 bank 容量每增加一倍时的平均变化；breadth 与 depth 的组成路径不同，效应仍需结合 matched-size 对照判读 | 像把台阶高度按“容量翻倍”标尺记录；两条路线的队列组成不同，不能只看数字判输赢 |
| d1−Direct 配对差 | 对零至一指标而言为负一至一 | 零表示不变；正值表示 d1 更高，负值表示 d1 更低；差十分之一等于绝对改变十个百分点 | 像两次考试分数相减：正数表示第二次更高，负数表示第二次更低 |
| breadth-heavy−depth-heavy 配对差 | 负一至一（含端点） | 零表示相同 module 总数下两种分配无差异；effective rank/stability 正值偏向 breadth，redundancy 负值偏向 breadth | 像给两队同样多的座位，再看“多去不同年级”和“同年级多听几个班”哪种安排更合适 |
| Technical-neighbor excess 差 | 单臂 excess 为负一至一；d1−Direct 为负二至二 | 负值表示 d1 减少额外同技术邻居聚集，正值表示聚集增强；负十分之一表示减少十个百分点 | 像先扣除“本来就同班”的影响，再看同款相机拍的照片是否仍爱挤在一起 |
| 跨队列结构相似度 | 负一至一（含端点） | 对两个队列各自的 `r length(unique(structural_entity_audit$entity))` 阶生物状态距离矩阵取上三角 Spearman；越高表示实体远近排序越能跨队列复现，d1−Direct 为正表示 d1 更稳定 | 像比较两座城市中同一组地标的远近次序；次序越一致，地图结构越可复现 |
| Module variance share | 零至一（含端点），所有 modules 之和为一 | 单个或 Top 组占比升高表示贡献更集中在少数 modules；下降表示更多 modules 共同参与 | 像把所有人的音量合成一百分，再看哪几个人说话最响 |
| Brier score | 零至一（含端点） | 越低表示概率预测越准；上升表示预测概率离正确答案更远；图中用“一减 Brier”后方向改为越高越好 | 像猜下雨概率：不仅看猜对没猜对，还看你有多确定，离答案越远扣分越多 |
| Spearman | 负一至一（含端点） | 升高表示重建后高低排序保留得更好；接近零表示排序不稳定，负值表示排序趋向反转 | 像把玩具按高矮重新排队：越接近一，重排后的顺序越像原来 |
| MAE / RMSE | 零至正无穷，没有统一上限 | 越低越好；RMSE 对少数特别大的错误惩罚更重，只能在相同量纲内比较 | MAE 像平均每次差几厘米；RMSE 会对“错得特别离谱”的那几次额外扣分 |
| 图中的误差重建分数 | 对“误差加一”取倒数，大于零且不超过一 | 一表示零误差；误差增大时分数向零下降，这是展示变换而不是原始 MAE/RMSE | 像把“错误越小越好”翻成“分数越高越好”，便于在各自分面内读取点的位置 |

Annoy 是用于加速近邻搜索的近似算法；exact kNN 则逐一计算距离，可视为本报告的检索参照。对每个抽查 query，neighbor recall 用“Annoy 找回的 exact 邻居数 ÷ exact 邻居总数”计算，再在抽查样本间取平均；一表示应找回的邻居一个都没有漏。Annoy 配置为 `r manifest$config$geometry$n_trees` 棵树，search budget 为 `r manifest$config$geometry$search_k`。与 exact kNN 对照后，Direct 和 d1 的 recall 分别为 `r fmt(annoy_recall_direct)` 和 `r fmt(annoy_recall_d1)`，均高于预设门槛 `r fmt(manifest$config$geometry$min_annoy_recall)`。因此，后续观察到的 top-k 差异不太可能主要由近似搜索漏邻居造成。

## d1 与癌种标签的判读边界

在 CCS 的 feature–cohort 融合中，新样本的 `cohort_id` 不作为输入标签；多个冻结队列模型 $F_m$ 分别从各自的队列视角读取同一份样本特征 $X$：

$$
d1(X)=\{F_1(X),F_2(X),\ldots,F_M(X)\}.
$$

用更直观的话说，同一个新样本像拿着同一幅画去问多位老师，每位老师只依据自己过去教过的 cohort 给出一个判断；d1 保存的是这一排判断，而不是把新样本硬塞回某个已知 cohort。这个设计的价值在于汇总不同队列视角，同时也意味着某位老师共同拥有的偏见可能被带入结果，所以后面既要检查新空间，也要检查技术来源和信息损失。

d1 同时编码样本内的 feature pattern 和固化在模型参数中的 cohort-derived prior，因此更适合被理解为“多个队列对新样本给出的证据向量”，而不是 Direct-GSClassifier 的无损副本。这种设计使新状态有可能跨越传统癌种边界，也为少量可部署 feature 如何随队列证据增加而扩展提供了解释。该概念与项目内的 [CCS 方法学讨论](../../docs/关于CCS框架的讨论.md)，以及论文中“low-input features + cohort consensus + transferable states”的表述一致。

| 本报告的观察 | 能支持的判断 | 不能支持的判断 |
|---|---|---|
| 癌种 top-k 与线性 readout 下降 | d1 弱化了旧癌种标签的可恢复性 | d1 没有新分型价值 |
| assay/platform/source excess 下降 | d1 减少了超出癌种构成可解释范围的技术来源聚集 | batch removal 已经成功，或所有生物结构都被保留 |
| Direct feature 不能完全重建 | d1 实施了有损、有方向的压缩 | 丢失的一定是下游任务所需信息 |
| 本轮未测 d2/d3/metaCCS/outcome | 现有证据只能约束 d1 与 cohort-bank scaling 的机制解读 | CCS 新状态发现或临床分层已胜出/失败 |

癌种结构仍应作为一项保护性参照。当前 CCS 论文认为，lineage-restricted states 与 broadly shared states 可以并存，下游机制也可能表现出 lineage-dependent realization。癌种可恢复性下降或许反映了预期中的“去癌种中心化”，但不能单独用来判定方法成功。要让这一解释成立，还需要证明新状态在未见 cohort 中保持稳定，携带跨癌种共享的生物信号，并保留可复现的 lineage-conditioned 差异。

## d1 对原生空间的改写

先比较空间几何，是因为 d1 若与 Direct 几乎完全相同，就没有形成新的表示；若结构被彻底打乱，也可能只是破坏信息。本节把 Direct 和 d1 写成两张矩阵 $X$ 与 $Y$：每一行是同一个样本，每一列是该表示中的一个特征。两张矩阵列数可以不同，但样本必须一一对应。本次几何指标使用分层抽取的 `r unique(geometry_metrics$sample_count)[1]` 个 reference 样本；Direct 按 reference 均值和标准差进行标准化，d1 也在 reference 边界内标准化，并让每个 module 对欧氏距离贡献等权。局部邻居使用 $k=$ `r max(manifest$config$geometry$k)`，Distance Spearman 最多抽取 `r manifest$config$geometry$distance_pairs` 个有序样本对进行估计。

Linear CKA 先对各列减去均值，再比较两张“样本两两关系表” $K=X_cX_c^\top$ 和 $L=Y_cY_c^\top$：

$$
\operatorname{CKA}(X,Y)=
\frac{\lVert X_c^\top Y_c\rVert_F\,\lVert X_c^\top Y_c\rVert_F}
{\lVert X_c^\top X_c\rVert_F\,\lVert Y_c^\top Y_c\rVert_F}.
$$

这个式子等价于两张关系表的余弦相似度：接近一表示整张样本地图方向一致，接近零表示缺少整体线性对应；它不是“保留信息的百分比”。Distance Spearman 则随机抽取样本对，分别计算它们在 Direct 和 d1 中的欧氏距离，再比较两份距离的名次；一表示被抽取样本对的远近次序完全一致，零表示没有稳定的名次关系。kNN Jaccard 更关注局部：对每个样本分别取得两种表示下的 $k$ 个最近邻，用“共同邻居数 ÷ 两份名单的并集数”计算，最后对样本取平均；一表示邻居名单完全相同，零表示没有共同邻居。三者分别对应“整张地图”“抽样远近排序”和“身边是谁”。

```{r figure-native-geometry, interp_check=TRUE}
# ==== Figure 1: Native geometry agreement (user-adjustable parameters) ====
fig1 <- list(
  # Canvas size in inches. Wider canvases leave room for metric labels.
  width_in = 6.2,
  height_in = 3.8,
  # Base font in pt. Values below 8 are avoided for print readability.
  base_size = 12,
  # Bar width and legend position; no in-panel title is used.
  bar_width = 0.68,
  legend_position = "none"
)

p1 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  geometry_metrics,
  ggplot2::aes(x = .data$metric_label, y = .data$metric_value)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = fig1$bar_width,
    fill = nature_colors[["blue"]]
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", .data$metric_value)),
    vjust = -0.45,
    size = 3.6
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.05),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Agreement",
    caption = "One frozen geometry estimate; CI and p-value are not estimable."
  ) +
  theme_nature_readable(
    base_size = fig1$base_size,
    x_text_angle = 0,
    legend_position = fig1$legend_position
  )

# Readability check: three short labels fit without rotation; values are printed
# above bars, and the non-estimable inference note is moved to the caption so it
# does not cover the data bars in PDF/JPG rendering.
fig1_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(
  p1, "figure-01-native-geometry", figure_dir, preview_dir, fig1,
  params$plot_preview_dpi
)
knitr::include_graphics(fig1_jpg)
```

结果解读：Figure `r 1L` 显示三个几何指标来自一次冻结 reference 几何计算；当前 RDS 未保存可按 cohort 重抽取的样本级矩阵或独立 geometry repeats，因此不能把单次 CKA、Distance Spearman 或 kNN Jaccard 的差异人为扩展成置信区间。这里将它们明确标记为 `not_estimable`，而不是用样本数当作独立重复。后续若保存每个 cohort 的几何矩阵或重复计算结果，再补充真正的 geometry-level CI。

```{r geometry-inference-table}
geometry_inference_table <- geometry_inference[, c(
  "endpoint", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_value", "n_sample",
  "unit", "method", "status", "reason"
)]
render_dt(geometry_inference_table, pageLength = 3L)
```

本次几何结果的直接解读是：CKA = `r fmt(metric_value("linear_cka"))`，说明 d1 与 Direct 的整体样本关系仍有较强一致性，但不是简单复制；Distance Spearman = `r fmt(metric_value("distance_spearman"))`，表示大尺度的远近排序仍保持清楚的正向关系。kNN Jaccard = `r fmt(metric_value("knn_jaccard"))`，即共同邻居约占两份邻居名单并集的 `r fmt_pct(metric_value("knn_jaccard"))`。由于两份名单都含相同数量的邻居，这一 Jaccard 值粗略对应每份名单约 `r fmt_pct(2 * metric_value("knn_jaccard") / (1 + metric_value("knn_jaccard")))` 的成员相同；这是便于理解的换算，不能代替逐样本分布。

CKA 与 Distance Spearman 共同表明全局关系和抽样远近排序仍有明显保留，而 kNN Jaccard 单独表明局部“谁紧挨着谁”发生了更大重排。**这三项指标的定义和标尺不同，不能因为 CKA 的数字大于 Jaccard，就把两者当作同一把尺子直接比较。** 形成新的证据空间是 CCS 实现新分型的必要条件，但三者都只描述“改了多少、改在什么尺度”，不能判断改写是否有益。还需结合技术边界是否减弱、新状态是否稳定、跨癌种生物锚点是否共享以及实际任务效用来评估。

## 外部癌种标签检索

这一步把未参与 reference atlas 构建的 query 放进地图，并且只允许它到其他 cohorts 的 reference 样本中找邻居，避免同一队列的技术或来源特征直接制造“近邻”。对 query $q$，top-k 癌种一致率计算为

$$
\operatorname{TopKRate}_q=
\frac{\sum_{j\in\mathcal{N}_k(q)}I(c_j=c_q)}{|\mathcal{N}_k(q)|},
$$

也就是前 $k$ 个邻居中与 query 同癌种的比例。MRR 是 mean reciprocal rank：若第一个同癌种邻居排在第 $r_q$ 名，则该样本得分为 $1/r_q$，最后对所有 query 取平均；排第一得一分，排第二得二分之一，越靠后分数越小。当前实现只在最多 `r max(manifest$config$geometry$k)` 名邻居内寻找首次命中，未找到记零，因此本报告中的 MRR 应理解为截断到前 `r max(manifest$config$geometry$k)` 名的 MRR。本次展示参数也是 `r params$display_k`，两者恰好一致；实现会对每个候选 $k$ 单独截断首次命中，因此若以后修改展示用 $k$，对应的 MRR 会同步成为新的 `MRR@k`。

图中展示的是每个样本的“d1 减 Direct”配对差，再在 cohort 内取平均。差值为正表示 d1 更容易恢复旧癌种标签，负值表示 d1 的邻域更少由旧癌种主导；它衡量的是 lineage recoverability，不是 CCS 新状态的正确率。虚线是所有 query 的样本级平均，因此样本多的 cohort 权重更大；散点则是各 cohort 内的样本均值，用于识别异质性。Top-k 与 MRR 的绝对值没有减去“该癌种在合格 reference 中所占比例”的机会基线，不同癌种不能只凭绝对分数横向判优；本报告主要依靠同一 query、同一 reference 候选池下的 d1−Direct 配对差保证比较口径一致。

### 检索差异的 cohort-level 推断

下面的推断以 query cohort 为统计单位。每次 bootstrap 对完整 cohort 有放回抽取，并在同一索引下保留 Direct/d1 配对；sign-flip 检验的零假设是平均配对差为零。`n_sample` 仅用于描述数据量，不被当成独立重复数。

```{r retrieval-inference-table}
retrieval_inference_table <- retrieval_inference[, c(
  "endpoint", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_value", "p_value_adj",
  "n_cohort", "n_sample", "resamples", "p_resamples", "p_method", "unit",
  "multiplicity_method", "status"
)]
render_dt(retrieval_inference_table, pageLength = 3L)
```

结论：该表给出的效应量、区间和配对检验共同描述了 cohort 重采样下的检索差异稳定性。

#### 检索推断结果解读

在预先指定的 `k =` `r params$display_k` 主要终点上，top-k 配对差估计为 `r fmt(retrieval_inference$estimate[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"])`，95% CI 为 `r fmt_ci(retrieval_inference[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate", ])`，双侧 p = `r fmt_p(retrieval_inference$p_value[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"])`（Holm 校正后 `r fmt_p(retrieval_inference$p_value_adj[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"])`）。这个区间描述 cohort 重采样下效应量的可变范围，不能替代生物学效用终点；若区间跨零或 p 值未达到 0.05，应表述为证据不足以拒绝零差异，而不是“没有差异”。MRR 与 top1 是次要终点，校正后的结果需结合其有效 cohort 数、方向和区间共同判读。

```{r figure-retrieval-cohort, interp_check=TRUE}
# ==== Figure 2: External retrieval cohort deltas (user-adjustable parameters) ====
fig2 <- list(
  # Larger height protects cohort labels from overlap; adjust with cohort count.
  width_in = 8.0,
  height_in = 8.5,
  base_size = 11,
  point_size = 2.2,
  zero_line_width = 0.55,
  legend_position = "bottom"
)
plot_retrieval <- retrieval_cohort_delta[
  retrieval_cohort_delta$sample_count >= params$min_cohort_n &
    retrieval_cohort_delta$metric %in%
      c("delta_top_k_label_rate", "delta_mrr"),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
plot_retrieval$metric <- factor(
  plot_retrieval$metric,
  levels = c("delta_top_k_label_rate", "delta_mrr"),
  labels = c("Top-k label rate", "Mean reciprocal rank")
)
retrieval_overall_plot <- data.frame(
  cohort = "Overall",
  metric = factor(
    c("Top-k label rate", "Mean reciprocal rank"),
    levels = levels(plot_retrieval$metric)
  ),
  estimate = c(retrieval_cohort_mean_delta, retrieval_cohort_mrr_delta),
  ci_low = c(
    retrieval_inference$ci_low[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"],
    retrieval_inference$ci_low[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "mrr"]
  ),
  ci_high = c(
    retrieval_inference$ci_high[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"],
    retrieval_inference$ci_high[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "mrr"]
  ),
  sample_count = NA_integer_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
plot_retrieval$ci_low <- NA_real_
plot_retrieval$ci_high <- NA_real_
retrieval_overall_plot <- retrieval_overall_plot[, names(plot_retrieval), drop = FALSE]
plot_retrieval <- rbind(plot_retrieval, retrieval_overall_plot)
retrieval_reference <- data.frame(
  metric = factor(
    c("Top-k label rate", "Mean reciprocal rank"),
    levels = levels(plot_retrieval$metric)
  ),
  estimate = c(retrieval_cohort_mean_delta, retrieval_cohort_mrr_delta),
  ci_low = c(
    retrieval_inference$ci_low[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"],
    retrieval_inference$ci_low[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "mrr"]
  ),
  ci_high = c(
    retrieval_inference$ci_high[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "top_k_label_rate"],
    retrieval_inference$ci_high[retrieval_inference$endpoint == "mrr"]
  )
)
cohort_order <- retrieval_delta_main$cohort[
  order(retrieval_delta_main$estimate)
]
plot_retrieval$cohort <- factor(plot_retrieval$cohort, levels = c(cohort_order, "Overall"))

p2 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  plot_retrieval,
  ggplot2::aes(x = .data$estimate, y = .data$cohort, color = .data$metric)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linewidth = fig2$zero_line_width,
    color = "grey55"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    data = retrieval_reference,
    ggplot2::aes(xintercept = .data$estimate, color = .data$metric),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = fig2$zero_line_width,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    data = plot_retrieval[plot_retrieval$cohort == "Overall", , drop = FALSE],
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = .data$ci_low, xmax = .data$ci_high),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.22,
    linewidth = fig2$zero_line_width,
    position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.45),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = fig2$point_size) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Top-k label rate" = nature_colors[["red"]],
      "Mean reciprocal rank" = nature_colors[["blue"]]
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Cohort-d1 minus Direct-GSClassifier",
    y = "External query cohort",
    color = "Metric",
    caption = "Overall row: cohort-equal mean and bootstrap 95% CI; dashed lines: cohort-equal means."
  ) +
  theme_nature_readable(
    base_size = fig2$base_size,
    x_text_angle = 0,
    legend_position = fig2$legend_position
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
      hjust = 0, lineheight = 0.95, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 6)
    )
  )

# Readability check: cohort labels use a tall canvas, the zero line makes gain/loss
# direction explicit, and the bottom legend does not cover data.
fig2_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(
  p2, "figure-02-external-retrieval-cohort-delta", figure_dir,
  preview_dir, fig2, params$plot_preview_dpi
)
knitr::include_graphics(fig2_jpg)
```

本次检索结果的直接解读是：在 $k=$ `r params$display_k` 时，top-k 癌种一致率从 Direct 的 `r fmt(direct_top_k_rate)` 降至 d1 的 `r fmt(d1_top_k_rate)`，相当于前 `r params$display_k` 个邻居中同癌种者平均从约 `r fmt(params$display_k * direct_top_k_rate, 1L)` 个降至 `r fmt(params$display_k * d1_top_k_rate, 1L)` 个；样本级配对平均差为 **`r fmt(retrieval_mean_delta)`**，即下降 `r fmt(100 * abs(retrieval_mean_delta), 1L)` 个百分点。MRR 同时从 `r fmt(retrieval_direct_mrr)` 降至 `r fmt(retrieval_d1_mrr)`，配对平均差为 `r fmt(retrieval_mrr_delta)`，说明第一个同癌种邻居总体出现得更靠后；由于倒数排名是非线性分数，这个差值不能直接翻译成“后移几名”。

两项指标同向下降，表明传统癌种标签对 d1 局部几何的主导作用较弱，但不能由此直接推断其生物学效用下降。正向差值最大的三个 cohort 依次为 `r retrieval_top$cohort[1]`、`r retrieval_top$cohort[2]` 和 `r retrieval_top$cohort[3]`；癌种可恢复性下降幅度最大的是 **`r retrieval_bottom$cohort[1]`**（`r fmt(retrieval_bottom$estimate[1])`）。**cohort 之间并不一致，说明 cohort bank 对 lineage 信号的重加权具有明显异质性。** 在据此收缩 d1 的适用范围之前，还需确认这些 cohort 是否对应可复现的共享状态。

```{r retrieval-top-table}
# Purpose: Expose the strongest external retrieval gains and losses with sample counts.
# Input: Cohort-level paired top-k cancer-type agreement deltas.
# Parameters: Top/bottom count from params$interpret_top_n.
# Output: Interactive table of concrete cohorts and effect directions.
retrieval_extremes <- rbind(
  transform(utils::head(retrieval_top, params$interpret_top_n), direction = "gain"),
  transform(utils::head(retrieval_bottom, params$interpret_top_n), direction = "loss")
)
render_dt(
  retrieval_extremes[, c("direction", "cohort", "estimate", "sample_count")],
  pageLength = 2L * params$interpret_top_n
)
```

#### 检索极端 cohort 解读

结论：极端 cohort 的方向差异是该表最重要的观察结果，应结合有效样本量与后续分层分析解释。

该表进一步展示了 lineage 重加权在具体 query cohort 中的差异。`r retrieval_top$cohort[1]` 与 `r retrieval_bottom$cohort[1]` 的方向相反，说明 cohort bank 对不同癌种的重加权强度和方向并不一致。下一步可分别按 assay/source 对这两类 cohort 分层，检验 d1 邻居在 pathway score、TME state 或其他非癌种锚点上是否更加一致。若跨 cohort 的状态一致性提高，且 Annoy/exact recall 仍高于 `r fmt(manifest$config$geometry$min_annoy_recall)`，便更支持这是“有目的的结构重构”，而不必要求癌种 top-k 差值转为正向。

## 外部癌种线性 readout

邻居检索只看“身边是谁”，所以还要用低复杂度线性模型检查旧癌种标签能否从整个表示中读出。这里的 linear readout 是一把固定复杂度的“探针”：在 reference cohorts 上训练线性分类器，再到未参与训练的 query 上预测癌种。若同一把简单探针在某种表示上得分更高，说明旧癌种信息更容易从该表示中被线性读取，但不等于该表示对所有任务都更好。

普通 accuracy 会让样本多的癌种占更大权重；balanced accuracy 先分别计算每个癌种的召回率，再对癌种等权平均：

$$
\operatorname{BalancedAccuracy}=
\frac{\sum_{c\in\mathcal{C}}\operatorname{Recall}_c}{|\mathcal{C}|}.
$$

因此，三成表示“各癌种召回率的平均值为百分之三十”，而不是“所有样本中恰好百分之三十正确”。分数越高，说明大、小癌种被更均衡地识别；随机基线取决于类别数和预测规则，不能机械套用二分类任务的一半。

### readout 差异的 query-cohort 推断

readout 推断固定已生成的外部 query 预测，以 query cohort 为 cluster 计算 paired bootstrap CI，并用 sign-flip 检验平均差为零。端到端重新拟合 reference 的不确定性不在本表中混入，避免把两种来源的变异解释成同一置信区间。

```{r readout-inference-table}
readout_inference_table <- readout_inference[, c(
  "endpoint", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_value", "p_value_adj",
  "n_cohort", "n_sample", "resamples", "p_resamples", "p_method", "unit",
  "multiplicity_method", "status"
)]
render_dt(readout_inference_table, pageLength = 1L)
```

结论：该表显示冻结 readout 的 query-cohort 差异与其 bootstrap 不确定性，并表明两者应在同一统计单位下比较。

#### readout 推断结果解读

cohort-level accuracy 的 query-cohort 配对差为 `r fmt(readout_inference$estimate[readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"])`，95% CI 为 `r fmt_ci(readout_inference[readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy", ])`，p = `r fmt_p(readout_inference$p_value[readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"])`（Holm 校正后 `r fmt_p(readout_inference$p_value_adj[readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"])`）。由于每个外部 query cohort 在当前数据中只有一个癌种标签，这个 endpoint 是单类别 cohort accuracy，而不是可估计的多类别 balanced accuracy；macro-AUROC 在这些 cohort 中均不可估计。该 95% CI 量化冻结模型在不同 query cohort 组成下的差异范围；这组 `r sum(readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy")` 个 P 值只描述冻结模型下的外部 query 稳定性，不能替代独立生物任务效用，也不能把样本数较大的 cohort 当作更多独立证据。

有效 query cohort 数为 `r readout_inference$n_cohort[readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"]`，样本数为 `r readout_inference$n_sample[readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"]`；因此 CI 的宽度主要反映 cohort 数量，而不是把每个 query 当作独立重复。

```{r figure-readout-cohort, interp_check=TRUE}
# ==== Figure 3: External linear readout cohort deltas (user-adjustable parameters) ====
fig3 <- list(
  width_in = 7.2,
  height_in = 7.5,
  base_size = 11,
  point_size = 2.4,
  zero_line_width = 0.55,
  legend_position = "none"
)
readout_plot <- readout_cohort[
  order(readout_cohort$delta_accuracy),
  c("cohort", "delta_accuracy"),
  drop = FALSE
]
readout_plot$ci_low <- NA_real_
readout_plot$ci_high <- NA_real_
readout_overall_plot <- data.frame(
  cohort = "Overall",
  delta_accuracy = readout_inference$estimate[
    readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"
  ],
  ci_low = readout_inference$ci_low[
    readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"
  ],
  ci_high = readout_inference$ci_high[
    readout_inference$endpoint == "cohort_accuracy"
  ],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
readout_plot <- rbind(readout_plot, readout_overall_plot)
readout_plot$cohort <- factor(
  readout_plot$cohort,
  levels = c(as.character(readout_plot$cohort[-nrow(readout_plot)]), "Overall")
)
p3 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  readout_plot,
  ggplot2::aes(x = .data$delta_accuracy, y = .data$cohort)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linewidth = fig3$zero_line_width,
    color = "grey55"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    data = readout_plot[readout_plot$cohort == "Overall", , drop = FALSE],
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = .data$ci_low, xmax = .data$ci_high),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.22,
    linewidth = fig3$zero_line_width,
    color = nature_colors[["purple"]],
    show.legend = FALSE,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = fig3$point_size,
    color = nature_colors[["purple"]]
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Cohort accuracy: Cohort-d1 minus Direct-GSClassifier",
    y = "External query cohort",
    caption = "Overall row: query-cohort mean and bootstrap 95% CI."
  ) +
  theme_nature_readable(
    base_size = fig3$base_size,
    x_text_angle = 0,
    legend_position = fig3$legend_position
  )

# Readability check: one metric avoids a redundant legend; a tall canvas keeps
# cohort names readable and the zero line exposes the sign of every paired effect.
fig3_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(
  p3, "figure-03-external-readout-cohort-delta", figure_dir,
  preview_dir, fig3, params$plot_preview_dpi
)
knitr::include_graphics(fig3_jpg)
```

本次 readout 结果的直接解读是：使用全部 reference cohorts 时，Direct-GSClassifier 在合并 query 样本上计算的 pooled balanced accuracy 为 `r fmt(readout_direct$balanced_accuracy)`，即各癌种召回率的等权平均约为 `r fmt_pct(readout_direct$balanced_accuracy)`；Cohort-d1 为 `r fmt(readout_d1$balanced_accuracy)`，约为 `r fmt_pct(readout_d1$balanced_accuracy)`。这个类别等权的 pooled balanced-accuracy 差为 `r fmt(readout_delta)`（`r ifelse(readout_delta > 0, "提高", ifelse(readout_delta < 0, "降低", "无变化"))` `r fmt(100 * abs(readout_delta), 1L)` 个百分点），但按 query cohort 等权的推断 endpoint 是单类别 cohort accuracy，估计为 `r fmt(readout_inference_delta)`；后者才是图中 CI 和 P 值对应的效应量。

当前数据中，d1 表现最好的 readout cohort 是 `r readout_top$cohort[1]`（单类别 accuracy 差值 `r fmt(readout_top$delta_accuracy[1])`），表现最差的是 `r readout_bottom$cohort[1]`（差值 `r fmt(readout_bottom$delta_accuracy[1])`）。**cohort 间差异表明，总体方向并不是所有 cohort 等幅变化。** 该比较采用 `r manifest$config$validation$inner_folds`-fold grouped CV，两种表示使用相同的预处理流程和调参预算，保证了比较口径一致。由于每个 query cohort 的有效类别数为 1，这一层只能作为 cohort accuracy 的稳定性诊断；结果不支持“d1 能让低复杂度模型更容易利用旧癌种标签”这一狭义主张；至于它是否更有利于读出 ICI response、pathway state 或新的 pan-cancer subtype，本实验尚无法回答。

## 癌种 readout 的样本效率

总体分数较低可能来自表示缺少可用的旧癌种信息，也可能只是训练样本不足。学习曲线把可用于训练的 reference cohorts 比例依次设为 `r paste(scales::percent(manifest$config$validation$learning_fractions, accuracy = 1), collapse = "、")`；横轴不是“随机抽取多少样本”，而是“允许模型看到多少比例的 reference cohorts”。若 d1 与 Direct 的差距随训练比例增加而趋近零，问题更偏向样本效率；若点估计持续远离零，则更像表示本身改变了可读信息。两臂每次共享相同 cohort subset 和同一批 query，确保比较的不是题目难度。

每个点是 `r manifest$config$validation$repeats` 次配对运行的均值；阴影按唯一 training-cohort design 做 cluster bootstrap 得到 95% CI。它表达训练 cohort 组成变化下均值的不确定性，不表示 95% 的单个 query 样本都落在阴影内，也不把共享同一 cohort subset 的算法种子重复当作独立设计。若有效唯一设计数不足，推断表会标记为 `not_estimable`。

### 学习曲线差异的重复设计推断

每个训练比例的统计单位是唯一 training-cohort design（由 cohort-subset hash 识别），而不是算法运行次数或其中的 query 样本。结果表同时保留模型运行数、唯一设计数和 `status`；唯一设计不足时显示 `not_estimable`，不将伪重复产生的区间当作确认性证据。

```{r learning-inference-table}
learning_inference_table <- learning_inference[, c(
  "requested_fraction", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_value", "p_value_adj",
  "n_run", "n_unique_design", "resamples", "p_resamples", "p_method", "unit",
  "multiplicity_method", "status", "reason"
)]
render_dt(learning_inference_table, pageLength = nrow(learning_inference_table))
```

结论：该表显示每个训练比例的差异及其区间，并表明不确定性应归因到唯一 training-cohort design，而非 query 样本数或同一设计下的重复拟合。

#### 学习曲线推断结果解读

在 100% reference fraction 的主要比较点，d1−Direct 点估计为 `r fmt(learning_inference$estimate[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1])`。虽然保存了 `r learning_inference$n_run[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1]` 次模型运行，但它们共享同一个完整 training-cohort set，唯一 cohort 设计数只有 `r learning_inference$n_unique_design[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1]`；因此该点的设计层 95% CI 与 P 值均标记为 **not estimable**。在 `r learning_inference$n_run[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1]` 次运行仅对应 `r learning_inference$n_unique_design[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1]` 个唯一设计时，重复拟合只反映算法种子波动，不能替代训练 cohort 组成的 bootstrap CI。

其余 `r sum(learning_inference$requested_fraction < 1)` 个 fraction 均以唯一 cohort-subset hash 为独立设计单位；只有有效唯一设计数达到预设下限时才报告 bootstrap CI 与配对 sign-flip P 值。这 `r sum(learning_inference$requested_fraction < 1)` 组校正 P 值属于样本效率敏感性分析，不能替代外层 cohort 重采样的端到端确认性证据。

```{r figure-learning-curve, interp_check=TRUE}
# ==== Figure 4: Paired learning curves (user-adjustable parameters) ====
fig4 <- list(
  width_in = 6.8,
  height_in = 4.4,
  base_size = 12,

  point_size = 2.5,
  point_alpha = 0.9,

p4 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  learning_summary,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$requested_fraction,

    group = .data$representation

) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
    ggplot2::aes(
      ymin = .data$ci_low_rep,
      ymax = .data$ci_high_rep,
      fill = .data$representation
    ),
    alpha = 0.14,
    color = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = fig4$line_size) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = fig4$point_size, alpha = fig4$point_alpha) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = manifest$config$validation$learning_fractions,
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(

fig4_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(
```

Figure `r 4L` 的解读显示：在上述四个训练比例下，d1 相对 Direct 的癌种 balanced-accuracy 点估计差依次为 `r paste(vapply(manifest$config$validation$learning_fractions, function(f) fmt(learning_delta$estimate[match(f, learning_delta$requested_fraction)]), character(1)), collapse = ", ")`。差值从最低训练比例时的 `r fmt(learning_delta$estimate[match(min(manifest$config$validation$learning_fractions), learning_delta$requested_fraction)])` 扩大到全部 reference cohorts 时的 `r fmt(learning_delta$estimate[match(1, learning_delta$requested_fraction)])`，**没有出现“数据增加后差距回到零”的点估计模式**。这表明点估计不支持差距仅由小训练集造成；但 100% 点只有 `r learning_inference$n_unique_design[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1]` 个唯一训练设计，推断状态为 `r learning_inference$status[learning_inference$requested_fraction == 1]`，其区间和 P 值不可估计。其余比例也仅有 `r manifest$config$validation$repeats` 个独立 cohort 设计。每个比例下两种表示共享 cohort subset hash 和外部 query hash，因此臂间差异不来自训练组成或测试样本漂移；这条曲线只衡量 cancer-type readout，不能据此认定 d1 对所有新分型任务都存在“过度压缩”。

## 主要终点的效应量与不确定性

这张综合图把三个分析模块的主要或预先指定比较点放在同一条零差异基线上。横轴始终是 d1−Direct，因此不同指标的绝对数值只用于判断各自区间是否跨零，不把不同量纲的效应大小直接横向排名。
